spectrum.basisUnits: g^(-1/2); M-orthonormal, distinct from dimensionless selected phi

reference.scope: free in-plane linear CST and independent area-lumped mass; first isolated positive mode; no pins, regularization, engine matrices, continuum convergence or physical-stock calibration

massProof.convention: reference UV triangle area times native areal density /3 per node; grams; no extra thickness or consistent-mass substitution

observation.targetScope: constructor xs/xt buffers retained raw; no inertial prediction exists before first actual substep
